scope: Bounded rank-8 native MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA topology-LoRA smoke training
summary: The dedicated H3 environment completed all six planned optimization steps and produced one reproducible rank-8 topology checkpoint.
evidence: Physical A800 GPU 5 was selected with 78,726 MiB free at preflight.
The fixed run used rank 8, learning rate 5e-5, one dataset repeat, one epoch, 448x256x39 inputs, and seed 20260811.
Training completed 6/6 steps and produced a 32,825,120-byte epoch-0 checkpoint with SHA-256 2a8ee75e76cda3ef610ffcf71eac7c11d2adab621d9d4f38a7920482dd66cce2.
lessons: The pinned NF4 H3 training path is operational in .venv-h3 and can hot-load the resulting LoRA into the inference pipeline.
limitations: Six optimizer steps are a smoke round, not evidence of visual improvement.
The training log exposes iteration timing but no useful scalar loss.
next_actions: Run a matched held-out inspect-flower inference and apply full-frame topology plus capability non-regression gates.
